metadata.scope: 2,065 unique CCD structure records. Structure identity is the master layer; source-origin labels describe how a record entered the catalog and are not evidence or usability classes.
metadata.method: Conservative rule-based first-pass screen for oral cyclic-peptide development relevance; not a substitute for literature, vendor, or synthesis review.

priority.label: 优先研发候选
priority.description: 结构较像可独立使用的氨基酸残基，且属于口服环肽常用的构象、主链极性或疏水性扫描方向；仍需确认保护策略、供应或合成路线。

conditional.label: 条件候选
conditional.description: 可能用于环肽，但用途更依赖具体结合位点、侧链电荷、交联设计或合成条件，不应默认改善口服性质。

reference.label: 仅结构参考
reference.description: CCD身份成立，但存在高复杂度、保护/端基状态、过高极性、非典型连接或单体可获得性疑问；不进入默认研发筛选库。

exclude.label: 明确排除
exclude.description: 自动规则识别为整分子缀合物、辅因子/核苷酸/脂质/金属复合物、完整肽、明显保护体或缺少可用于常规肽键形成的羧基。

evidence-reviewed-residue.label: 已确认有CCD定义的非天然氨基酸残基
evidence-reviewed-residue.description: 结构身份明确，且CCD官方peptide-linking单体类型或人工来源审核支持其作为非标准肽链残基；是否易于购买、合成或改善口服性仍需分别判断。

pdb-peptide-occurrence.label: PDB肽中出现，独立单体资料待补
pdb-peptide-occurrence.description: PDB序列确认该结构进入过肽，但尚未全部确认它是否以独立保护单体加入、如何偶联或是否用于环肽。

special-reference.label: 特殊用途构件／结构参考
special-reference.description: 包括天然产物特殊残基、连接体、交联片段、战头和非典型骨架；有研究资料也不等于普通氨基酸单体。

candidate-pending.label: 结构像氨基酸，肽合成单体身份待确认
candidate-pending.description: CCD已明确其化学结构，但现有资料尚不足以证明它可作为独立氨基酸单体合成并接入肽链。专利提及会单独显示，不自动升级为已确认使用。

excluded-nonmonomer.label: 非单体／明确排除
excluded-nonmonomer.description: 已识别为完整药物、短肽、辅因子、保护体、复杂缀合物或其他不应作为普通氨基酸单体推荐的结构。

statusMeta.cyclic-title-clue: 代表PDB标题含直接环肽／宏环线索
statusMeta.mixed-title-context: 代表PDB同时出现环肽与非环肽情境
statusMeta.constrained-peptide-clue: 代表PDB含二硫键、订书或其他约束肽线索
statusMeta.linear-title-clue: 代表PDB标题仅见明确线性肽线索
statusMeta.context-unresolved: 仅凭代表PDB标题无法判定环化情境

pdbContextAudit.scope: Automated representative-title context audit for records previously classified as PDB peptide occurrence. Results remain machine-screened until source-level manual review.

statusMeta.likely-independent-monomer: 结构上较像可独立偶联的氨基酸单体
statusMeta.special-reactive-candidate: 带特殊反应基团，需按设计用途核查
statusMeta.strong-nonmonomer-signal: 存在较强的非普通单体信号
statusMeta.unresolved: 现有结构字段不足以进一步判断

pendingCandidateTriage.method: Conservative structural-field triage of the candidate-pending class. No literature or supplier confirmation is inferred.

pdbManualReviewBatch9.scope: Fixed-order manual review of 100 previous PDB short-polymer hits; PDB occurrence is not treated as proof of ordinary amino-acid monomer identity.

pdbManualReviewBatch10.scope: Second fixed-order manual review of 100 previous PDB short-polymer hits using official representative entry titles and polymer sequences.

pdbUnresolvedIdentityReview.scope: Source-level resolution of all eight records left in the PDB-occurrence bucket after the CCD linkage-type audit; decisions distinguish introduced amino-acid analogues from post-expression modifications, catalytic intermediates, inhibitor adducts and oxidation products.

pendingIdentityReviewBatch1.scope: Chemical-identity review of the first 50 candidate-pending records using official wwPDB CCD identity/parent mapping, PubChem exact-structure registry records, wwPDB BIRD definitions and entry-level reaction context where applicable.

pendingIdentityReviewBatch2.scope: Chemical-identity review of the next 50 previously unreviewed candidate-pending records using official wwPDB CCD definitions, PubChem exact-structure registry records and entry-level reaction context where applicable.

pendingIdentityReviewBatch3.scope: Chemical-identity review of the third fixed-order set of 50 previously unreviewed candidate records using official wwPDB CCD definitions, PubChem exact-structure mappings and entry-level reaction context where needed.

pendingIdentityReviewBatch4.scope: Chemical-identity review of the fourth fixed-order set of 50 previously unreviewed candidates using official wwPDB CCD definitions, PubChem exact-structure mappings and entry-level biochemical context for boundary cases.

pendingIdentityReviewBatch5.scope: Final chemical-identity review of all 70 records left unresolved after batches 1-4, using official CCD definitions, PubChem mappings and entry-level context for conjugates, haptens, buffers, drug fragments and biosynthetic intermediates.

researchEvidenceAlignment.model: CCD-first; research evidence is linked to the structure master by exact CCD ID.

corePriorityReview.name: 4-HYDROXYPROLINE

corePriorityReview.recommendation: 适合Pro位点转角、氢键和极性扫描；闭环与顺反异构影响需在具体序列中测定。

corePriorityReview.conclusion: 确认为N-Me-Ala构件，并有环孢素衍生物及KRAS宏环抑制剂直接结构证据
corePriorityReview.synthesisEvidence: N-Me-Ala进入多类合成肽和宏环骨架的PDB记录明确。
corePriorityReview.cyclicEvidence: PDB 24HT为KRAS G12D宏环肽抑制剂AP2527；PDB 1CWI为环孢素衍生物。
corePriorityReview.oralEvidence: 环孢素具有完整骨架口服先例；AP2527及单点N-Me-Ala的口服性尚不能由结构推出。
corePriorityReview.recommendation: 适合小体积位点的氢键供体屏蔽扫描，需与构象和细胞渗透数据配对。

corePriorityReview.name: N-METHYLVALINE
corePriorityReview.conclusion: 确认为N-甲基Val构件，并有环孢素和actinomycin类宏环直接结构证据
corePriorityReview.synthesisEvidence: PDB确认N-Me-Val进入多类宏环天然产物；不自动证明商业保护单体或任意序列偶联可行。
corePriorityReview.cyclicEvidence: PDB 1BCK与1A7Y分别提供环孢素类似物和actinomycin D环境。
corePriorityReview.oralEvidence: 环孢素具有完整骨架口服先例；单个N-Me-Val的贡献不能从这些结构单独归因。
corePriorityReview.recommendation: 适合同时扫描氢键供体屏蔽与疏水性，需监测偶联困难和构象改变。
